materials.synthesis_route: direct sintering (dissolved nitrates, dried 120 C 24 h, calcined 1000 C 4 h)
materials.notes: Best-performing composition. Total conductivity from EIS (Table 2); ionic from I-V at 500 C = 0.15 S/cm. Electrolyte thickness 521 um measured from cross-sectional SEM after test (pressed target ~650 um). Peak power at other temperatures: 857 (470 C), 628 (440 C), 410 (410 C actually 424), 205 (380 C) mW/cm2. Proton conduction confirmed by BZCY oxide-ion blocking layer (OCV 1.09 V, Pmax 656 mW/cm2 with blocker) and H+ transference number 55-81% between 420-560 C. Highest temperature measured = 500 C (rule: closest to 600 C).

extraction_notes: Full-text extraction. Activation energy not reported in text. Relative density not reported. Sintering step is a 1000 C 4 h powder calcination; cell was additionally pre-sintered at 550 C 2 h before test. Paper reports both total conductivity (EIS) and ionic conductivity (from I-V slopes) at 500 C for all three compositions — total is used as primary conductivity_S_cm per the more standard convention; ionic value noted in per-material notes. Discrepancy between pressed pellet thickness (~650 um) and SEM-measured electrolyte thickness (521 um for 30ADC) noted.
